name: Boltless shelving bay 1600 x 600 x 2300 mm
description:
A boltless (rivet) steel shelving bay of the kind used throughout warehouses, stockrooms, archives and workshops: four corner posts, front and back beams at each level, shelf decks, and diagonal bracing on the side frames. Five levels.

External dimensions: width 1600 mm, depth 600 mm, height 2300 mm.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 924 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Boltless warehouse shelving bay, 1600 x 600 x 2300 mm - true-scale GLB of a five-level steel racking bay sized to the euro container module.
